firstPlayerRule: The hero players decide together which hero takes the first turn. All heroes take their turns before the overlord.
officialTieBreak: If the heroes cannot agree on an order, they play clockwise starting with the player to the overlord’s left.
clarifications: The heroes may agree on a different order each round.
